target.raw: \begin{aligned} \inf_{\gamma\in\Pi(\alpha,\beta)} \int c(x,y)\dd\gamma(x,y) &= \inf_{\gamma\in\Mc_+(X\times Y)} \sup_{\phi\in C_b(X),\ \psi\in C_b(Y)} \\ &\quad\bigg\{\int c(x,y)\dd\gamma(x,y)\\ &\quad+\int\phi(x)\dd\alpha(x)+\int\psi(y)\dd\beta(y) \\ &\quad-\int\big(\phi(x)+\psi(y)\big)\dd\gamma(x,y)\bigg\}\\ &= \sup_{\phi\in C_b(X),\ \psi\in C_b(Y)} \bigg\{\int\phi(x)\dd\alpha(x)+\int\psi(y)\dd\beta(y)\\ &\quad+\inf_{\gamma\in\Mc_+(X\times Y)} \int\big(c(x,y)-\phi(x)-\psi(y)\big)\dd\gamma(x,y)\bigg\}\\ &= \sup_{\substack{\phi\in C_b(X),\ \psi\in C_b(Y)\\ \phi(x)+\psi(y)\leq c(x,y)\ \forall(x,y)}} \int\phi(x)\dd\alpha(x)+\int\psi(y)\dd\beta(y). \end{aligned}
